source.title: Derry Journal, 21 May 1952, p. 2 ("County and rural council nominations: four contests in Limavady"); Londonderry Sentinel, 22 May 1952, p. 2 ("3 critical contests for Unionists in Limavady R.D."); Londonderry Sentinel, 19 May 1949, p. 6 ("County Londonderry: Limavady - seventeen retiring councillors returned unopposed; the members returned unopposed"); Derry Journal, 10 June 1958, p. 5 ("Notice of result of elections: Rural District of Limavady, 1958")
source.publisher: Derry Journal (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: returned unopposed: 'There are no changes regarding the following eighteen outgoing members who are returned unopposed ...' (Derry Journal 21 May 1952 p2; Londonderry Sentinel 22 May 1952 p2). The list gives names and townlands, not divisions.

note: Triennial election of the 23 electoral divisions of Limavady rural district, one member each, polled on 5 June 1952. Twenty-seven candidates were nominated and four divisions were contested; the Nationalists gained two seats and with them control of the council. Sixteen of the nineteen unopposed members added from the nominations report (Derry Journal, 21 May 1952, p. 2; Londonderry Sentinel, 22 May 1952, p. 2): Ballykelly as the report gives it, the rest from their divisions at the 1949 return. Aghanloo, Feeny and The Highlands (W. J. Thompson, James O'Kane, John Alcorn) are held, as for 1949 (round-2 gap-fill, 7 Nov 2026). division inferred from the 2 June 1949 return (recorded from the Londonderry Sentinel, 19 May 1949, p. 6, with the division of the 1946 return: Thomas Harbinson for Keady; Londonderry Sentinel, 19 October 1946, p. 6); the Derry Journal of 21 May 1952, p. 2, names the member as an outgoing member returned unopposed. The 1958 Returning Officer's notice (Derry Journal, 10 June 1958, p. 5) again returns him for this division. Returned unopposed.
